paragraphs.text: In the dry south of the country, a research farm has been testing ways to grow vegetables with very little fresh water. The project began in 2016 after two years of drought left many local farmers without an income.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: The farm’s greenhouses are cooled by seawater, which is pumped from the coast and trickled over cardboard panels. As the water evaporates, the air inside becomes cooler and more humid, so plants lose less moisture through their leaves.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Some of the evaporated water is collected again as it condenses on cold pipes, providing fresh water for irrigation. The system produces around 5,000 litres a day, enough for roughly a hectare of tomatoes.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Energy for the pumps comes from solar panels on the greenhouse roofs. Engineers first placed the panels over the whole roof, but tomato yields fell because the plants received too little light, and the panels now cover only one side.
paragraphs.label: D

paragraphs.text: The researchers are cautious about the cost. Building a greenhouse of this kind is still more expensive than a conventional one, and the method only works close to the sea. Nevertheless, several local farmers have visited the site, and two have asked for help in building smaller versions.
paragraphs.label: E

items.quote: The project began in 2016 after two years of drought left many local farmers without an income
items.prompt: the event that led to the start of the project

explanation.en: “The project began in 2016 after two years of drought” — the drought led to the start → A.
explanation.kk: «The project began in 2016 after two years of drought» — жоба құрғақшылықтан кейін басталған → A.
explanation.ru: «The project began in 2016 after two years of drought» — засуха стала причиной начала проекта → A.

items.quote: tomato yields fell because the plants received too little light, and the panels now cover only one side
items.prompt: a design change made after a disappointing result

explanation.en: Yields fell (“tomato yields fell”), so the design changed: the panels “now cover only one side” → D.
explanation.kk: Өнім азайған («tomato yields fell»), сондықтан панельдерді өзгерткен: «now cover only one side» → D.
explanation.ru: Урожай упал («tomato yields fell»), и панели перенесли: «now cover only one side» → D.

items.quote: so plants lose less moisture through their leaves
items.prompt: an explanation of how the plants are helped to keep water

explanation.en: Cool, humid air means “plants lose less moisture through their leaves” → B. Paragraph C is also about water, but water for irrigation, not plants keeping it.
explanation.kk: Ылғалды салқын ауа «plants lose less moisture through their leaves» дегенді білдіреді → B. C абзацы да су туралы, бірақ суаруға арналған су туралы, өсімдіктің ылғалды сақтауы туралы емес.
explanation.ru: Влажный прохладный воздух означает, что «plants lose less moisture through their leaves» → B. Абзац C тоже о воде, но о воде для полива, а не о том, как растения её сохраняют.

items.quote: The system produces around 5,000 litres a day
items.prompt: the quantity of water the system provides

explanation.en: The amount of water is given in paragraph C: “The system produces around 5,000 litres a day”. Paragraph B is also about water but gives no quantity → C.
explanation.kk: Су мөлшері C абзацында аталған: «The system produces around 5,000 litres a day». B абзацы да су туралы, бірақ онда көлем жоқ → C.
explanation.ru: Количество воды названо в абзаце C: «The system produces around 5,000 litres a day». Абзац B тоже о воде, но там нет объёма → C.

items.quote: several local farmers have visited the site, and two have asked for help in building smaller versions
items.prompt: interest shown by people outside the project

explanation.en: Local farmers visited and asked for help: “two have asked for help in building smaller versions” → E. Farmers appear in A too, but not showing interest.
explanation.kk: Жергілікті фермерлер келіп, көмек сұраған: «two have asked for help in building smaller versions» → E. A абзацында фермерлер аталады, бірақ жобаға қызығушылық жоқ.
explanation.ru: Местные фермеры приезжали и просили помочь: «two have asked for help in building smaller versions» → E. В A фермеры упомянуты, но интереса к проекту там нет.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–5. The reading passage has five paragraphs, A–E. Which paragraph contains the following information? Write the correct letter, A–E.
